question: How many customers are based in Brazil?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users WHERE country = 'Brasil'

question: What is the total revenue from customers in the USA?
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(oi.sale_price) FROM order_items oi JOIN users u ON oi.user_id = u.id WHERE u.country = 'United States'

question: How many female customers do we have?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users WHERE gender = 'F'

question: How much revenue came from men's products bought by customers in China?
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(oi.sale_price) FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.id JOIN users u ON oi.user_id = u.id WHERE p.department = 'Men' AND u.country = 'China'

question: How many customers are in Germany?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users WHERE country IN ('Germany', 'Deutschland')

question: How much revenue did we keep in 2023 once cancellations and returns are taken out?
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(sale_price) FROM order_items WHERE year(created_at) = 2023 AND status NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Returned')

question: What is the revenue of items that are currently in transit to customers?
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(sale_price) FROM order_items WHERE status = 'Shipped'

question: How many orders were returned?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE status = 'Returned'

question: How many orders included at least one item from the Jeans category?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT oi.order_id) FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.id WHERE p.category = 'Jeans'

question: How many different customers have bought a dress?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT oi.user_id) FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.id WHERE p.category = 'Dresses'

question: How many customers acquired through Facebook placed an order in 2023?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.user_id) FROM orders o JOIN users u ON o.user_id = u.id WHERE u.traffic_source = 'Facebook' AND year(o.created_at) = 2023

question: How many distinct brands were sold out of the Memphis distribution center?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT p.brand) FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.id JOIN distribution_centers d ON p.distribution_center_id = d.id WHERE d.name = 'Memphis TN'

question: How many different Swim products were sold in 2021?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT oi.product_id) FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.id WHERE p.category = 'Swim' AND year(oi.created_at) = 2021

question: How many orders had more than 3 items?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE num_of_item > 3

question: What was total revenue in Q4 2022?
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(sale_price) FROM order_items WHERE CAST(created_at AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2022-10-01' AND DATE '2022-12-31'

question: How many order items were ordered in the first half of 2023?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM order_items WHERE CAST(created_at AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2023-01-01' AND DATE '2023-06-30'

question: Today is 2024-01-15. What was our revenue last quarter?
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(sale_price) FROM order_items WHERE CAST(created_at AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2023-10-01' AND DATE '2023-12-31'

question: Today is 2023-07-10. How many order items were ordered last month?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM order_items WHERE CAST(created_at AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2023-06-01' AND DATE '2023-06-30'

question: Today is 2023-05-20. How many order items have been ordered so far this year, including today?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM order_items WHERE CAST(created_at AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2023-01-01' AND DATE '2023-05-20'

question: Today is 2023-03-02. How many orders were placed last year?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE year(created_at) = 2022

question: Show monthly revenue for 2023.
gold_sql: SELECT CAST(date_trunc('month', created_at) AS DATE), SUM(sale_price) FROM order_items WHERE year(created_at) = 2023 GROUP BY 1

question: How did revenue in 2023 compare with 2022? Give each year's total.
gold_sql: SELECT year(created_at), SUM(sale_price) FROM order_items WHERE year(created_at) IN (2022, 2023) GROUP BY 1

question: Which 3 brands sold the most units in the Women's department?
gold_sql: SELECT p.brand, COUNT(*) AS n FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.id WHERE p.department = 'Women' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 3

question: Which product category brings in the most revenue from customers in China?
gold_sql: SELECT p.category, SUM(oi.sale_price) AS r FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.id JOIN users u ON oi.user_id = u.id WHERE u.country = 'China' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY r DESC LIMIT 1

question: Which distribution center had the lowest revenue in 2023?
gold_sql: SELECT d.name, SUM(oi.sale_price) AS r FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.id JOIN distribution_centers d ON p.distribution_center_id = d.id WHERE year(oi.created_at) = 2023 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY r ASC LIMIT 1

question: Which 5 US states have the most customers?
gold_sql: SELECT state, COUNT(*) AS n FROM users WHERE country = 'United States' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 5

question: Rank traffic sources by revenue from completed items, highest first.
gold_sql: SELECT u.traffic_source, SUM(oi.sale_price) AS r FROM order_items oi JOIN users u ON oi.user_id = u.id WHERE oi.status = 'Complete' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY r DESC

question: What was the average sale price per item in each department in 2022?
gold_sql: SELECT p.department, AVG(oi.sale_price) FROM order_items oi JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.id WHERE year(oi.created_at) = 2022 GROUP BY 1

question: How many customers aged 18 to 25 placed an order in 2023?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.user_id) FROM orders o JOIN users u ON o.user_id = u.id WHERE u.age BETWEEN 18 AND 25 AND year(o.created_at) = 2023

question: How many orders placed in 2022 were not cancelled?
gold_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE year(created_at) = 2022 AND status != 'Cancelled'
